name: getStarTransactions
description: Returns the bot's Telegram Star transactions in chronological order. On success, returns a [StarTransactions](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#startransactions) object.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of transactions to skip in the response

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of transactions to be retrieved. Values between 1-100 are accepted. Defaults to 100.
